Read the official notification carefully before applying.
Download the application form from the official website: https://lakhimpur.assam.gov.in.

Read the official notification carefully before applying. Download the application form from the official website: https://lakhimpur.assam.gov.in. Ensure the application reaches before the last date: 25-09-2026. Keep a photocopy of the submitted application form for future reference.

faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for the District Commissioner Lakhimpur recruitment?
faq.answer: The last date to submit the application form for the District Commissioner Lakhimpur recruitment is 25th September 2026. Ensure your application reaches the designated address by this date.

faq.question: Q2. How many vacancies are available for Co-ordinator FRA and MIS/FRA Associate posts?
faq.answer: There are a total of 2 vacancies announced for the Co-ordinator FRA and MIS/FRA Associate positions in the District Commissioner Lakhimpur recruitment.

faq.question: Q3. What is the educational qualification required for the Co-ordinator FRA post?
faq.answer: For the Co-ordinator FRA post, candidates must possess a Master's degree in Social Science or Social Work, along with knowledge of basic IT/Computer Applications. Prior experience in rural development is preferred.

faq.question: Q4. What is the salary offered for the MIS/Program (FRA) / Associate FRA position?
faq.answer: The selected candidate for the MIS/Program (FRA) / Associate FRA position will receive a monthly salary of Rs. 25,000/-.

faq.question: Q5. Is there any application fee for this recruitment?
faq.answer: No, there is no application fee mentioned for any category (General/OBC, SC/ST) in the official notification for this recruitment.

faq.question: Q6. What is the maximum age limit for the applicants?
faq.answer: The maximum age limit for all posts is 35 years, as of 01 January 2026. Age relaxation will be provided as per government norms.

faq.question: Q7. What is the selection process for these posts?
faq.answer: The selection process for the District Commissioner Lakhimpur recruitment will involve an Interview/Test followed by Document Verification.

faq.question: Q8. In which mode should the application be submitted?
faq.answer: Candidates are required to apply through the offline mode by sending their application form to the official address mentioned in the notification.

faq.question: Q9. What is the experience required for the MIS/Program (FRA) / Associate FRA post?
faq.answer: For the MIS/Program (FRA) / Associate FRA post, candidates need a minimum of 2 years of experience in large-scale data processing and management, in addition to a Diploma in IT/Computer Applications.
